landing.heroTitle: Learn English vocabulary every day, the right way
landing.heroDescription: Enroll in courses built by teachers, practice typing words with images and pronunciation, earn points and climb the leaderboard with classmates in every course.

track.vocabularyDescription: Learn vocabulary with images, pronunciation, and live typing practice.
track.toeicDescription: Vocabulary and practice organized by TOEIC exam topics.
track.ieltsDescription: Expand your academic vocabulary for the IELTS exam.
track.vstepDescription: Prepare vocabulary for the VSTEP English proficiency exam.

landing.rankingTitle: Leaderboard ranked by score in every course
landing.rankingDescription: Every set of 10 words: a correct answer is +10 points, a wrong answer is -2 points. Your accumulated score decides your position on the course leaderboard.
